summary.text: Terry Burke Dotson is an unenrolled candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 7th Worcester District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She has been a candidate for the seat in every general election since 2014, each time against Republican incumbent Paul Frost.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Dotson as the Democratic nominee for the 7th Worcester District in 2014, 2016 and 2018, as an independent candidate in 2020 and 2022, and as an unenrolled candidate in 2024.
Frost won each of those general elections, including 2024, when he received 69.1 percent of the vote to her 30.7 percent.
